vsm1.6:72.1: Vicchiddakaṃ yuddhamaṇḍale vā corāṭaviyaṃ vā susāne vā yattha rājāno core chindāpenti.
vsm1.6:72.2: Araññe vā pana sīhabyagghehi chinnapurisaṭṭhāne labbhati.
vsm1.6:72.3: Tasmā tathārūpaṃ ṭhānaṃ gantvā sace nānādisāyaṃ patitampi ekāvajjanena āpāthamāgacchati iccetaṃ kusalaṃ.
vsm1.6:72.4: No ce āgacchati, sayaṃ hatthena na parāmasitabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:72.6: Tasmā ārāmikena vā samaṇuddesena vā aññena vā kenaci ekaṭṭhāne kāretabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:72.8: kattarayaṭṭhiyā vā daṇḍakena vā ekaṅgulantaraṃ katvā upanāmetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:72.10: Tattha uggahanimittaṃ majjhe chiddaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:73.2: Uggahanimittaṃ panettha tahiṃ tahiṃ khāyitasadisameva upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:74.1: Vikkhittakampi vicchiddake vuttanayeneva aṅgulaṅgulantaraṃ kāretvā vā katvā vā
vsm1.6:75.2: Tasmā tattha gantvā vuttanayeneva aṅgulaṅgulantaraṃ kāretvā vā katvā vā
vsm1.6:75.4: Uggahanimittaṃ panettha paññāyamānaṃ pahāramukhaṃ viya hoti.
vsm1.6:76.1: Lohitakaṃ yuddhamaṇḍalādīsu laddhappahārānaṃ hatthapādādīsu vā chinnesu bhinnagaṇḍapīḷakādīnaṃ vā mukhato paggharamānakāle labbhati.
vsm1.6:76.2: Tasmā taṃ disvā ‘‘lohitakapaṭikkūlaṃ lohitakapaṭikkūla’’nti manasikāro pavattetabbo.
vsm1.6:76.3: Ettha uggahanimittaṃ vātappahatā viya rattapaṭākā calamānākāraṃ upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:77.1: Puḷavakaṃ dvīhatīhaccayena kuṇapassa navahi vaṇamukhehi kimirāsipaggharaṇakāle hoti.
vsm1.6:77.2: Apica taṃ soṇasiṅgālamanussagomahiṃsahatthiassaajagarādīnaṃ sarīrappamāṇameva hutvā sālibhattarāsi viya tiṭṭhati.
vsm1.6:77.3: Tesu yattha katthaci ‘‘puḷavakapaṭikkūlaṃ puḷavakapaṭikkūla’’nti manasikāro pavattetabbo.
vsm1.6:77.4: Cūḷapiṇḍapātikatissattherassa hi kāḷadīghavāpiyā anto hatthikuṇape nimittaṃ upaṭṭhāsi.
vsm1.6:77.6: Paṭibhāganimittaṃ sālibhattapiṇḍo viya sannisinnaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:78.1: Aṭṭhikaṃ ‘‘seyyathāpi passeyya sarīraṃ sivathikāya chaḍḍitaṃ aṭṭhisaṅkhalikaṃ samaṃsalohitaṃ nahārusambandha’’ntiādinā (ma. ni. 3.154) nayena nānappakārato vuttaṃ.
vsm1.6:78.2: Tattha yattha taṃ nikkhittaṃ hoti, tattha purimanayeneva gantvā
vsm1.6:78.3: samantā pāsāṇādīnaṃ vasena sanimittaṃ sārammaṇaṃ katvā
vsm1.6:78.6: Taṃ pana vaṇṇato setanti olokentassa na upaṭṭhāti,
vsm1.6:79.5: Tassa tassa aṭṭhino pariyantavasena paricchedato vavatthapetvā
vsm1.6:79.6: yadevettha pākaṭaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhāti, taṃ gahetvā appanā pāpuṇitabbā.
vsm1.6:79.7: Tassa tassa aṭṭhino ninnaṭṭhānathalaṭṭhānavasena pana ninnato ca thalato ca vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:79.11: Dvinnaṃ pana aṭṭhikānaṃ ghaṭitaghaṭitaṭṭhānavasena sandhito vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:79.13: Sabbattheva pana ñāṇaṃ cāretvā imasmiṃ ṭhāne idamaṭṭhīti samantato vavatthapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:79.14: Evampi nimitte anupaṭṭhahante nalāṭaṭṭhimhi cittaṃ saṇṭhapetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:79.16: evaṃ idaṃ ekādasavidhena nimittaggahaṇaṃ ito purimesu puḷavakādīsupi yujjamānavasena sallakkhetabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:80.1: Idañca pana kammaṭṭhānaṃ sakalāyapi aṭṭhikasaṅkhalikāya ekasmimpi aṭṭhike sampajjati.
vsm1.6:80.2: Tasmā tesu yatthakatthaci ekādasavidhena nimittaṃ uggahetvā
vsm1.6:80.4: Idha uggahanimittampi paṭibhāganimittampi ekasadisameva hotīti vuttaṃ,
vsm1.6:80.8: Ekaṭṭhikepi ca uggahanimittena bībhacchena bhayānakena bhavitabbaṃ.
vsm1.6:81.1: Imasmiṃ hi okāse yaṃ aṭṭhakathāsu vuttaṃ, taṃ dvāraṃ datvāva vuttaṃ.
vsm1.6:81.2: Tathā hi tattha ‘‘catūsu brahmavihāresu dasasu ca asubhesu paṭibhāganimittaṃ natthi.
vsm1.6:81.4: Dasasu ca asubhesu nibbikappaṃ katvā paṭikkūlabhāveyeva diṭṭhe nimittaṃ nāma hotī’’ti
vsm1.6:81.7: Uggahanimittaṃ virūpaṃ bībhacchaṃ bhayānakaṃ hutvā upaṭṭhātī’’tiādi vuttaṃ.
vsm1.6:81.10: Apica mahātissattherassa dantaṭṭhikamattāvalokanena sakalitthisarīrassa aṭṭhisaṅghātabhāvena upaṭṭhānādīni cettha nidassanānīti.
vsm1.6:82.1:
Iti asubhāni subhaguṇo, dasasatalocanena thutakitti;
Yāni avoca dasabalo, ekekajjhānahetunīti.
vsm1.6:82.2:
Evaṃ tāni ca tesañca, bhāvanānayamimaṃ viditvāna;
Tesveva ayaṃ bhiyyo, pakiṇṇakakathāpi viññeyyā.
vsm1.6:84.4: Iti yādisaṃ yādisaṃ sakkā hoti laddhuṃ, tādise tādise uddhumātakapaṭikkūlaṃ vinīlakapaṭikkūlanti evaṃ nimittaṃ gaṇhitabbamevāti
vsm1.6:85.1: Visesato cettha uddhumātakaṃ sarīrasaṇṭhānavipattippakāsanato saṇṭhānarāgino sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.6:85.3: Vipubbakaṃ kāyavaṇapaṭibaddhassa duggandhabhāvassa pakāsanato mālāgandhādivasena samuṭṭhāpitasarīragandharāgino sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.6:85.5: Vikkhāyitakaṃ maṃsupacayasampattivināsappakāsanato thanādīsu sarīrappadesesu maṃsupacayarāgino sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.6:85.9: Puḷavakaṃ kāyassa anekakimikulasādhāraṇabhāvappakāsanato kāye mamattarāgino sappāyaṃ.
vsm1.6:85.11: evaṃ rāgacaritabhedavasenāpi dasadhā asubhappabhedo vuttoti veditabbo.
vsm1.6:86.2: seyyathāpi nāma aparisaṇṭhitajalāya sīghasotāya nadiyā arittabaleneva nāvā tiṭṭhati,
vsm1.6:86.4: evameva dubbalattā ārammaṇassa vitakkabaleneva cittaṃ ekaggaṃ hutvā tiṭṭhati,
vsm1.6:87.2: ‘‘addhā imāya paṭipadāya jarāmaraṇamhā parimuccissāmī’’ti evamānisaṃsadassāvitāya ceva
vsm1.6:87.4: ‘‘bahuṃ dāni vetanaṃ labhissāmī’’ti ānisaṃsadassāvino pupphachaḍḍakassa gūtharāsimhi viya,
vsm1.6:88.1: Dasavidhampi cetaṃ asubhaṃ lakkhaṇato ekameva hoti.
vsm1.6:88.3: Tadetaṃ iminā lakkhaṇena na kevalaṃ matasarīre,
vsm1.6:88.5: hatthikkhandhagataṃ rājānaṃ olokentassa saṅgharakkhitattherūpaṭṭhākasāmaṇerassa viya ca jīvamānakasarīrepi upaṭṭhāti.
vsm1.6:88.6: Yatheva hi matasarīraṃ, evaṃ jīvamānakampi asubhameva.
vsm1.6:88.7: Asubhalakkhaṇaṃ panettha āgantukena alaṅkārena paṭicchannattā na paññāyati.
vsm1.6:89.1: Pakatiyā pana idaṃ sarīraṃ nāma atirekatisataaṭṭhikasamussayaṃ asītisatasandhisaṅghaṭitaṃ
vsm1.6:89.7: Yassa ubhohi akkhīhi akkhigūthako paggharati, kaṇṇabilehi kaṇṇagūthako,
vsm1.6:89.9: adhodvārehi uccārapassāvā, navanavutiyā lomakūpasahassehi asucisedayūso paggharati.
vsm1.6:89.12: yathājātova pharusavippakiṇṇakeso hutvā gāmena gāmaṃ vicaranto rājāpi pupphachaḍḍakacaṇḍālādīsu aññataropi samasarīrapaṭikkūlatāya nibbiseso hoti,
vsm1.6:89.13: evaṃ asuciduggandhajegucchapaṭikkūlatāya rañño vā caṇḍālassa vā sarīre vemattaṃ nāma natthi.
vsm1.6:90.6: Tato iminā āgantukena alaṅkārena paṭicchannattā tadassa yāthāvasarasaṃ asubhalakkhaṇaṃ asañjānantā purisā itthīsu, itthiyo ca purisesu ratiṃ karonti.
vsm1.6:90.7: Paramatthato panettha rajjitabbakayuttaṭṭhānaṃ nāma aṇumattampi natthi.
vsm1.6:91.1: Tathā hi kesalomanakhadantakheḷasiṅghāṇikauccārapassāvādīsu ekakoṭṭhāsampi sarīrato bahi patitaṃ
vsm1.6:91.6: avijjandhakārapariyonaddhā attasineharāgarattā ‘‘iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ niccaṃ sukhaṃ attā’’ti gaṇhanti.
vsm1.6:91.8: aṭaviyaṃ kiṃsukarukkhaṃ disvā rukkhato apatitapupphaṃ ‘‘ayaṃ maṃsapesī’’ti vihaññamānena jarasiṅgālena samānataṃ āpajjanti. Tasmā –
vsm1.6:92.1:
Yathāpi pupphitaṃ disvā, siṅgālo kiṃsukaṃ vane;
Maṃsarukkho mayā laddho, iti gantvāna vegasā.
vsm1.6:92.2:
Patitaṃ patitaṃ pupphaṃ, ḍaṃsitvā atilolupo;
Nayidaṃ maṃsaṃ aduṃ maṃsaṃ, yaṃ rukkhasminti gaṇhati.
vsm1.6:92.3:
Koṭṭhāsaṃ patitaṃyeva, asubhanti tathā budho;
Aggahetvāna gaṇheyya, sarīraṭṭhampi naṃ tathā.
vsm1.6:92.4:
Imañhi subhato kāyaṃ, gahetvā tattha mucchitā;
Bālā karontā pāpāni, dukkhā na parimuccare.
vsm1.6:92.5:
Tasmā passeyya medhāvī, jīvato vā matassa vā;
Sabhāvaṃ pūtikāyassa, subhabhāvena vajjitaṃ.
vsm1.6:93.2:
Duggandho asuci kāyo, kuṇapo ukkarūpamo;
Nindito cakkhubhūtehi, kāyo bālābhinandito.
vsm1.6:93.3:
Allacammapaṭicchanno, navadvāro mahāvaṇo;
Samantato paggharati, asuci pūtigandhiyo.
vsm1.6:93.4:
Sace imassa kāyassa, anto bāhirako siyā;
Daṇḍaṃ nūna gahetvāna, kāke soṇe nivārayeti.
vsm1.6:94.1:
Tasmā dabbajātikena bhikkhunā jīvamānasarīraṃ vā hotu
Matasarīraṃ vā yattha yattha asubhākāro paññāyati, tattha tattheva nimittaṃ gahetvā
vsm1.6:94.3:
Iti sādhujanapāmojjatthāya kate visuddhimagge
Samādhibhāvanādhikāre
Asubhakammaṭṭhānaniddeso nāma
Chaṭṭho paricchedo.
